prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup
Asset type: high-fidelity north-star desktop website composition, 1536x1024 landscape
Primary request: Design the PGKhata marketing homepage as a refined operational ledger for Indian PG owners. Composition option C: a centered editorial promise across the upper third with navigation above and one dominant action directly below. The lower two-thirds forms a wide horizontal cause-and-effect strip: a tenant register row on the left expands into a large itemized bill in the center, then crosses a crisp WhatsApp delivery seam into a payment status ledger on the right. The connection should feel like one continuous workflow, not separate cards. Show the opening of the next section below as a dense statement about ₹0 forever and no tenant app.
Style/medium: production-grade web UI comp, flat front-on website screenshot, semantic interface—not an illustration, poster, or device scene
Composition/framing: desktop landscape; centered headline; continuous edge-to-edge workflow strip with overlapping paper layers and ruled seams; bill in the center is the focal object; primary CTA clearly visible above it
Color palette: established PGKhata system only—warm paper #faf9f8, white #ffffff, ledger green #154212, hover green #2d5a27, ink #1a1c1c, muted gray-green #72796e, pale leaf #bcf0ae, tiny semantic amber/red accents for status
Materials/textures: matte paper fields, receipt-like ruled structure without photoreal paper texture, hairline borders, one soft downward shadow under the itemized bill; no decorative gradient, glow, glass, noise, or photography
Typography: characterful editorial serif for headline; clean compact grotesk sans for navigation, buttons, labels, amounts, and status
Text (verbatim): brand name PGKhata and headline Rent collection, without the chaos. only. Render all other copy as indistinct interface lines or concise data marks; Indian rupee symbols and believable data may appear.
Product proof: visually unmistakable four-step loop—tenant details, itemized rent/electricity/other bill, WhatsApp send cue, paid/pending tracking; credible illustrative Indian names and room/bed references
Responsive implication: the continuous strip can become a vertical receipt stack on mobile without changing reading order
Constraints: no bento grid, no repeated icon cards, no phone or laptop frame, no browser chrome, no fake testimonial, no invented customer claims, no unrelated app dashboard navigation, no watermark
